name: The Silent Choir
summary: Three singers, each singing a Requiem every 25 seconds. A finished Requiem takes 60% of every hero's health and makes the Choir stronger.
counter: Interrupt every Requiem: Pummel (Warrior), Kick (Rogue), Counterspell (Spellblade), Time Lock (Chronomancer) — any stun works too.
